items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Sidney Ayrton influenced a lot of clarinet players. He played wonderfully.

ctx.x: Do you think any clarinet players influenced you much?

Yeah, well anybody, everybody is influenced by somebody else. Although I never did try to copy anybody's style, you subconsciously play like somebody else or like more than one individual, you hit things that you like that somebody else plays and you're going to imitate it without trying to. Rap, for instance, was a great influence on most clarinet players in his time, late Leon Rapolo. He influenced a lot, Sidney Ayrton influenced a lot of clarinet players. He played wonderfully.
A lot of things I hear him do I hear on records by other guys, I think. Oh yeah. I think the Chicago guys picked something from him.
